_comment: Head metadata for the three funnel pages. This file is the source that 07 mirrors into Webflow
page settings, so the local package and the Designer never drift.
ALL THREE PAGES ARE noindex. That is deliberate and it is how the practice already treats its
existing paid landing page: /invisalign-offer-pasadena returns 200 and is absent from
sitemap.xml. The site already ranks six Invisalign URLs (a service page, five geo pages) plus a
blog post, and a new page competing with them would take traffic the practice already owns.
Excluding these three from the index is what actually prevents that; the slug only prevents
The thank-you page would additionally be a bad search result on its own terms: it tells the
reader their form was submitted, which is false for anyone arriving from Google.
JSON-LD is on the landing page only, and it describes the practice, not the offer. An Offer or
Product schema would need a price validity window and an availability claim that nobody has
confirmed yet: whether the $3,379 promotion is still current is an open question with the
client. aggregateRating is deliberately absent for the same reason the pages print no review
count: it was 486 on 2026-08-20 and it moves, and what to publish is Gauge Hill's copy task.
